name: Dumbbell Incline Reverse Fly
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a low incline and lie chest down with feet braced.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging straight below your shoulders and palms facing inward.
Raise both arms out to the sides with softly bent elbows until they align with your back.
Pause briefly squeezing your rear delts, then lower the dumbbells under control beneath your shoulders.
tips: Keep your chest supported on the pad throughout the lift.
Keep your neck neutral and avoid shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.
